mapper.sql: record_id, maintenance_no, equipment_id, record_type, sub_type, status, plan_id, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, maintainer, maintainer_id, maintenance_team, description, before_status, after_status, spare_parts, spare_parts_cost, labor_cost, total_cost, result, abnormal_desc, acceptor, acceptance_time, acceptance_opinion, downtime_hours, related_fault_id, inspection_data, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, details
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM mes_maintenance_record WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM mes_maintenance_record WHERE status IN (1, 2) -- 已计划或进行中 AND plan_end_time < NOW() ORDER BY plan_end_time ASC

SELECT record_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(total_cost) as totalCost, AVG(downtime_hours) as avgDowntime FROM mes_maintenance_record WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY record_type
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM mes_maintenance_record GROUP BY status

SELECT e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, COUNT(mr.record_id) as maintenanceCount, SUM(mr.total_cost) as totalCost FROM mes_equipment e LEFT JOIN mes_maintenance_record mr ON e.equipment_id = mr.equipment_id WHERE e.is_active = 1 GROUP BY e.equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name ORDER BY maintenanceCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(total_cost) as totalCost, SUM(spare_parts_cost) as sparePartsCost, SUM(labor_cost) as laborCost FROM mes_maintenance_record WHERE YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_maintenance_record SET status = 3, -- 已完成 actual_end_time = #{actualEndTime}, result = #{result}, acceptor = #{acceptor}, acceptance_time = #{acceptanceTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM mes_maintenance_record WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY actual_start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT mr.*, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, e.equipment_type, e.workshop, e.location FROM mes_maintenance_record mr LEFT JOIN mes_equipment e ON mr.equipment_id = e.equipment_id WHERE mr.record_id = #{recordId}
